phase: P26 - Updater, signing, installers, and rollback

sourceManifest.algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted path-tab-contentSHA lines with a trailing newline

trustLab.keyPairs: Fresh Ed25519 self-signed primary and rotated keys generated at runtime
verified: canonical metadata is stable across object insertion order
version, URL, artifact hash, upgrade floor and signing time are cryptographically bound
downloaded bytes must match the hash in the signed manifest
minimum key epochs retire old keys
unknown and duplicate key identities fail closed
future, stale and expired evidence fails closed
only HTTPS URLs without embedded credentials or fragments are accepted
downgrades are refused before trust work

productionOwner.order: plan and downgrade policy -> canonical manifest trust -> observed artifact hash -> apply decision

notClaimed: No production updater key or code-signing certificate was generated or used.
No platform installer was signed, installed, repaired, upgraded, rolled back or uninstalled.
The Tauri updater stays inactive and its public key stays a placeholder.
